nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and changed in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string, set to 'MVCMG' in constructor.
Token name string, set to 'MVCMG Token' in constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in constructor.
Total token supply, assigned in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, allowance owner, balance owner and access-control subject.
Checked addition helper returning a+b with require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction helper requiring b <= a.
Checked multiplication helper verifying a == 0 || c / a == b.
Checked division helper requiring b > 0.
Sets owner = msg.sender at deployment.
onlyOwner function that stores _newOwner into newOwner.
Promotes newOwner to owner if msg.sender equals newOwner.
Initializes metadata, supply and pre-allocates all tokens to the fixed deployer address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender's receiveApproval callback.
Payable fallback that always reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function performing an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens to owner.
Unchecked-style addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded only by require(c >= a).
Balance subtraction/addition for msg.sender and 'to' in transfer.
Balance subtraction, allowance subtraction and balance addition in transferFrom.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with user-supplied spender and data.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a user-supplied token address.
revert() executed inside the payable fallback function.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Parameter to of transfer.
Parameter tokens of transfer.
Parameter spender of approve.
Parameter from of transferFrom.
Parameter to of transferFrom.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall; also the external callback target.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall.
Parameter data forwarded to the receiveApproval callback.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token.
Local return variable c of safeAdd.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping in approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping in transfer.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] and subtracts it.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
transferFrom reads and decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and writes balances for from and to.
transfer reads and writes balances for msg.sender and to.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
acceptOwnership assigns newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to promote ownership.
transfer calls safeSub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd on balances[to].
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on balances[to].
transfer performs balance arithmetic updates guarded by SafeMath.
transferFrom performs allowance and balance arithmetic updates.
safeAdd performs c = a + b with a require-based overflow check.
transferOwnership stores _newOwner into newOwner.
approveAndCall invokes the untrusted spender contract receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into a user-supplied token contract.
fallback executes revert() to reject ETH.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership body.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferAnyERC20Token body.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, a caller-dependent ownership check.
The untrusted spender callback can reenter transferFrom and consume the allowance before the outer call settles.
The external ERC20 token call can reenter transfer while transferAnyERC20Token executes.
_newOwner is written into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
to is the credit recipient in transfer.
tokens is the transferred amount in transfer.
spender keys the allowed mapping in approve.
from is the debit account in transferFrom.
to is the credit account in transferFrom.
tokens is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
spender keys the allowance and is the external callback target in approveAndCall.
tokens sets the allowance and is forwarded to the callback in approveAndCall.
data is forwarded to the receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress selects the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens is the amount passed to the external transfer in transferAnyERC20Token.
local c holds and returns the computed sum in safeAdd.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner only exists to be stored into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner only serves as the lookup key inside balanceOf.
Parameter to is only used as the credit account inside transfer.
Parameter tokens is only used as the transfer amount inside transfer.
Parameter spender is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
Parameter from is only used as the debit account inside transferFrom.
Parameter to is only used as the credit account inside transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is only used as the transfer amount inside transferFrom.
Parameter spender is only used as allowance key and external callback target inside approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is only used as allowance value and callback argument inside approveAndCall.
Parameter data is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback inside approveAndCall.
Parameter tokenAddress is only used to select the external token contract in transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens is only used as the external transfer amount in transferAnyERC20Token.
Local variable c only carries the addition result out of safeAdd.
